async generator method expression.description:

yield.description:
ES2015
The yield keyword is used to pause and resume a generator function (function* or legacy generator function).

yield*.description:
ES2015
The yield* expression is used to delegate to another generator or iterable object.

Iterator Helpers: .map().description:
ES2025
iterator.map(mapperFn)
return a new lazy Iterator Helper yielding each element transformed by `mapperFn`. Available directly on any Iterator/generator — no need to materialize an Array first.

Iterator Helpers: .filter().description:
ES2025
iterator.filter(filtererFn)
return a new lazy Iterator Helper yielding only the elements for which `filtererFn` returns truthy.

Iterator Helpers: .take().description:
ES2025
iterator.take(limit)
return a new lazy Iterator Helper yielding at most the first `limit` elements, then stopping (short-circuits the underlying iterator).

Iterator Helpers: .drop().description:
ES2025
iterator.drop(limit)
return a new lazy Iterator Helper that skips the first `limit` elements, then yields the rest.

Iterator Helpers: .flatMap().description:
ES2025
iterator.flatMap(mapperFn)
like `.map()`, but `mapperFn` may return an iterable whose elements are flattened one level into the resulting Iterator Helper.

Iterator Helpers: .reduce().description:
ES2025
iterator.reduce(reducerFn[, initialValue])
consumes the iterator eagerly and returns the accumulated result, like `Array.prototype.reduce()`.

Iterator Helpers: .some().description:
ES2025
iterator.some(fn)
consumes the iterator (stopping early on the first match) and returns a boolean, like `Array.prototype.some()`.

Iterator Helpers: .every().description:
ES2025
iterator.every(fn)
consumes the iterator (stopping early on the first non-match) and returns a boolean, like `Array.prototype.every()`.

Iterator Helpers: .find().description:
ES2025
iterator.find(fn)
consumes the iterator (stopping early on the first match) and returns the matching element, or `undefined`, like `Array.prototype.find()`.

Iterator.concat().description:
ES2026 (Iterator Sequencing)
Iterator.concat(...iterablesOrIterators)
return a new lazy Iterator that yields every value from each argument in order, one argument's iterator exhausted before the next begins. Accepts a mix of iterators and plain iterables (arrays, Sets, etc.).

Iterator Helpers: .toArray().description:
ES2025
iterator.toArray()
materializes the (possibly infinite-looking, lazily-chained) iterator into a real Array.
